title: Shift-aware score transport for privacy auditing without retraining
abstract: arXiv:2610.31549v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Privacy auditing empirically assesses privacy leakage by using membership inference attacks to establish lower bounds on privacy loss. We consider an observational auditing setting in which the auditor cannot insert canaries, control data inclusion, or retrain the target model, and must instead rely on fixed sets of known members and non-members. This setting is relevant for large deployed models or when retraining is restricted by computational or access constraints. In this case, non-members available for auditing may differ in distribution from the training data, causing membership-inference scores to be skewed due to the distribution shift. We address this problem by estimating the counterfactual in-distribution non-member score distribution using the available out-of-distribution (OOD) non-members. translated_title: 面向无需重训练的隐私审计的分布偏移感知分数传输方法
translated_abstract: 隐私审计通过使用成员推断攻击来建立隐私损失的下界，从而对隐私泄露进行实证评估。我们考虑一种观测式审计场景：审计者无法插入金丝雀样本、无法控制数据是否被纳入训练、也无法重新训练目标模型，而只能依赖固定的已知成员与非成员样本集合。这一场景适用于已部署的大型模型，或重训练受计算资源和访问权限限制的情况。在这种情况下，可用于审计的非成员样本的分布可能与训练数据不同，导致成员推断分数因分布偏移而产生偏差。为解决这一问题，我们利用可获得的分布外（OOD）非成员样本，估计反事实的分布内非成员分数分布。我们提出的方法从OOD非成员样本中学习数据表示与成员推断分数之间的关系，并对分数分布进行传输校正……
tldr: 提出一种分布偏移感知的分数传输方法，通过从分布外非成员样本中学习并校正成员推断分数分布，实现了在无法重训练模型情况下的隐私审计。
en_tdlr: Proposes a shift-aware score transport method that learns from out-of-distribution non-members to correct membership-inference score distributions, enabling privacy auditing of deployed models without retraining.
